name: Side plank
why: Strong sides keep you long and controlled when you land sideways.

setup.space: A strip of floor about 2 m long.
setup.parent: Kneel in front, level with the hips.

steps: Lie on one side, elbow under the shoulder, legs stacked.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Rest the top hand on your hip and look straight ahead.
Hold for the time, lower, then do the other side.

mistakes.fix: Push the bottom hip up toward the ceiling.
Stack the shoulders and hips on top of each other.

parent_check: Straight line from head to feet
stop_if: Pain in the shoulder, lower back or hip
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Hips drop and cannot be lifted again (end the set)

easier.variant: Side plank from the knees, with the knees bent behind you.
easier.use_when: The hips drop before the time is up.

harder.variant: Reach the top arm straight up during the hold.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean two sessions in a row, and the owner approves.
